items.text: prednáška = lecture
items.picture: A big lecture hall with tiered rows of seats: a professor speaks at the front by a projector screen, and Emma takes notes among a crowd of students.

items.text: seminár = seminar, small class
items.picture: A seminar in the Slovak classroom, the desks pushed together into one big table: six students and pani Horváthová sit round it in discussion; Oksana talks with her hands while Emma listens.

items.text: knižnica = library
items.picture: The university library: tall shelves and long reading tables with green lamps. Emma carries a stack of books to the librarian's desk.

items.text: rozvrh hodín = timetable
items.picture: Emma pins her weekly timetable, a grid of coloured blocks, to the wall above her desk in the dorm room.

items.text: skúška = exam
items.picture: An exam in the Slovak classroom: students bent over their papers in silence; Emma chews her pen as pani Horváthová walks slowly between the desks.

items.text: referát = paper, presentation
items.picture: Late evening at her dorm desk, Emma types a paper on her laptop, books and notes spread around her and a cold cup of tea at her elbow.

items.text: Prepáčte, že meškám. = Sorry I'm late. (formal)
items.picture: Emma bursts into the classroom out of breath, scarf flying, mid-apology; pani Horváthová, by the board, turns with a calm, kind look.

items.text: Emma comes in late. What does pani Horváthová say?
Koľko je hodín? = What time is it?
items.picture: In the porter's lodge, Emma asks pán Kováč the time; he turns round to look at the big clock on the wall behind him.

items.text: Je pol ôsmej. = It's half past seven. (7:30)
items.picture: The alarm clock on Emma's bedside table shows half past seven; Lucia, already dressed, shakes a sleeping Emma by the shoulder.

items.text: Je štvrť na deväť. = It's a quarter past eight. (8:15)
items.picture: Outside the university's main building, the big clock over the entrance shows a quarter past eight; Emma and other students hurry up the steps.

items.text: Ráno vstávam o siedmej. = In the morning I get up at seven.
items.picture: Seven in the morning in the dorm room, the window pale with sunrise: Emma sits up in bed and stretches, her alarm clock beside her.

items.text: Sprchujem sa. = I take a shower.
items.picture: Emma in the dorm shower behind a half-drawn curtain, shampoo foam in her hair, singing to herself.

items.text: Raňajkujem. = I'm having breakfast.
items.picture: Emma, still sleepy, has breakfast at the dorm kitchen table: a buttered roll, a boiled egg and a mug of tea.

items.text: Najprv sa sprchujem, potom raňajkujem. = First I shower, then I have breakfast.
items.picture: A two-step picture with an arrow between. Left: the shower curtain is drawn and only Emma's head shows above it, her hair full of shampoo, steam rising. Right: Emma at breakfast with her hair wrapped in a towel.

items.text: Doobeda mám prednášky. = In the morning I have lectures.
Učím sa. = I'm studying.
Večer som unavená. = In the evening I'm tired. (woman speaking)
items.picture: Late evening in the dorm room, the window dark: Emma, worn out, has flopped onto her bed still in her clothes and fallen fast asleep.

items.text: Tomáš missed the bus. What does he say?
items.picture: Tomáš, his laptop bag bouncing, runs after a city bus that is just pulling away from the stop.

items.text: ešte and už
items.picture: Two halves, both at eight in the morning in the dorm room. Left: Lucia still asleep while her alarm clock rings. Right: Lucia already up, pulling on her sweater.

items.text: Lucia hasn't had breakfast yet. What does she say?
items.picture: In the dorm kitchen, Emma holds out a plate of toast; Lucia, coat already on and hand on her stomach, reaches for a slice gratefully.
